first_comment: Source: La Tribune de l'Hôtellerie, 27 Oct 2026 — https://latribunedelhotellerie.com/marriott-cape-town-edition-ouverture-142-chambres/
post_text:
@Marriott International has opened The Cape Town EDITION, a 142-room hotel on the V&A Waterfront and the brand's first address in Africa.

The hotel sits on Quay 7, facing Table Mountain. Its interiors are by Neri&Hu, the Shanghai studio of @Lyndon Neri and @Rossana Hu, working with local craftspeople. More than six million hand-laid bricks clad the façades.

Leonie Andereya is general manager. Executive chef Phil Carmichael leads Shale, the main restaurant, and EAVE, a rooftop restaurant and bar with a heated pool. The art was chosen with Design Network Africa and Southern Guild.

The signal: Cape Town is drawing the lifestyle-luxury brands that once stopped at Europe and the Gulf. With @EDITION, a brand built on nightlife and design now bets on the city's year-round appeal, not just the southern summer.

Which African city do you expect to see next on the luxury lifestyle map?
